title: Conduction App Manifest v2
description: v2 schema for the JSON-driven page and navigation manifest consumed by @conduction/nextcloud-vue. Introduces a uniform widgets[] array on every page type with a per-slot grid coordinate system, a typed actions[] discriminator, and the required $schema field for version detection. v1 manifests continue to validate against app-manifest.schema.json (unchanged).

$schema.description: REQUIRED in v2. Must point to the v2 schema URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ConductionNL/nextcloud-vue/main/src/schemas/app-manifest-v2.schema.json. Presence of this field enables the validator to dispatch to the v2 Ajv instance rather than the v1 hand-rolled validator.

version.description: Semver of the manifest content. Bump when the manifest changes meaningfully. Used for cache busting and app-builder migration tracking. Distinct from the schema's own version.

dependencies.description: Nextcloud app IDs that MUST be installed and enabled for this app to function. CnAppRoot checks each via useAppStatus(appId). Sentinels (@resolve:*) are NOT allowed here — resolved at build time against known app IDs.

runtime.description: Runtime context data injected into the manifest by the backend (e.g. OpenRegister) at serve time. Carries per-user fields that visibleIf context-path predicates resolve against. The canonical sub-object is 'user', which exposes user-specific flags and role information.

user.description: Per-user runtime context. Populated by the backend for authenticated requests. All fields are optional; the FE predicate evaluator treats missing fields as undefined.

menu.description: Top-level navigation entries rendered by CnAppNav.

pages.description: Page definitions dispatched by CnPageRenderer. Each page's id is also its vue-router route name. Ids MUST be unique across the array; uniqueness is enforced by validateManifestV2 as a post-schema check.

menuItem.description: A top-level navigation entry. May contain one level of nested children.

id.description: Unique identifier for this menu entry. Sentinels (@resolve:*) are NOT allowed — this is a router invariant.

label.description: i18n translation key resolved by the consuming app's t() function at render time.

icon.description: CSS class for the icon (e.g. 'icon-checkmark') or MDI component name.

route.description: Vue-router route name (matches a pages[].id) that this entry navigates to. Sentinels (@resolve:*) are NOT allowed — this is a router invariant.

order.description: Display order in the menu. Items without an order render last.

permission.description: Permission string the user must hold for this entry to render.

section.description: Where the entry renders inside CnAppNav. 'main' (default) places it in the top list. 'settings' places it in the footer group.

href.description: External URL. When set, the entry opens the URL in a new tab instead of dispatching a vue-router navigation.

action.description: Built-in action to invoke when the entry is clicked. Closed enum.

visibleIf.description: Optional display condition evaluated at render time.

dynamicSource.description: Optional dynamic source for populating nested menu items from a data endpoint. Carry-forward from v1.3.0.

children.description: Nested entries. Only one level of nesting is supported.

menuItemLeaf.description: A nested menu entry. Has no further children.

dynamicSource.description: Dynamic source configuration for populating menu items from a backend endpoint. Carry-forward from v1.3.0 — identical shape to v1.

url.description: URL to fetch menu items from.

labelField.description: Property name in the response items to use as the menu entry label.

idField.description: Property name in the response items to use as the menu entry id.

routeField.description: Property name in the response items to use as the menu entry route.

widgetEntry.description: A uniform widget placement entry used on every page type in v2. Replaces the v1 widgetDef + layoutItem pair with a single shape. The cross-field constraint gridX + gridWidth <= 12 CANNOT be expressed in JSON Schema (arithmetic over sibling fields) — it is documented here and enforced at runtime by validateManifestV2() as a post-schema check. Failure message: "Widget '{widgetKey}' in slot '{slot}': gridX ({gridX}) + gridWidth ({gridWidth}) exceeds 12".

widgetKey.description: Registry key identifying the widget component. Resolved against the customComponents map passed to CnAppRoot at boot.

slot.description: Placement slot. Valid values: body, sidebar, header-actions, footer, modal (literals) or tab:<id> / section:<id> (pattern). Per-slot grid constraints are enforced via allOf/if-then below.

gridX.description: 0-based column start position. gridX + gridWidth MUST be <= 12 (enforced by post-schema check, not JSON Schema).

gridY.description: 0-based row start position. For header-actions slot, MUST be 0 (enforced by allOf/if-then).

gridWidth.description: Column span (1-12). For sidebar slot, MUST be exactly 1 (enforced by allOf/if-then). gridX + gridWidth MUST be <= 12 (enforced by post-schema check).

props.description: Optional widget-specific props passed at render time. Shape is widget-specific; not constrained here.

tabGroup.description: Optional: groups this widget into a named tab within the slot. Only meaningful for tab:* and section:* slots.

dataSource.description: Optional declarative data binding. Carry-forward from v1 widgetDef.dataSource — same shape.

_note.description: Human-readable note. Optional on most widgets. REQUIRED when the containing page has type 'custom' — in that case this field must document why a standard page type was not feasible.

allOf.description: sidebar slot: gridWidth MUST equal 1. The sidebar is a fixed-width panel; widgets always span the full width.
header-actions slot: gridY MUST equal 0. All header action widgets live in a single row.

slotValue.description: Valid slot value. Either a literal slot name (body, sidebar, header-actions, footer, modal) or a tab:<id> / section:<id> pattern string.

oneOf.description: Named tab or section slot. Format: tab:<id> or section:<id> where <id> is at least one character.

dataSource.description: Declarative data binding for widgets. Two forms: (a) shorthand {register, schema, filter?, aggregate: 'count'} — the lib builds a count query and resolves to {count}. (b) raw {graphql: {query, variables?, selectors}} — the lib issues the query and runs selectors against the response. Carry-forward from v1.3.0 widgetDef.dataSource.

filter.description: Shorthand: filter map inlined into the generated query.

aggregate.description: Shorthand aggregation. Currently only count is supported.

selectors.description: Map of result-prop name to dot-path selector.

action.description: A typed page action with a discriminator field. The type field determines behaviour: handler (registry function), open-modal (modal by id), open-page (named route), navigate (URL). When type is omitted, it defaults to 'handler' (back-compatibility with v1.3.0 action declarations). The Ajv instance is compiled with useDefaults: true so the default is applied during validation.

id.description: Unique action identifier within the page's actions array.

label.description: i18n key resolved by the consuming app's t() function at render time.

type.description: Action behaviour discriminator. Defaults to 'handler' when omitted (back-compat with v1.3.0). handler: calls a registry function; open-modal: opens a modal by target id; open-page: navigates to a named route; navigate: navigates to a URL.

target.description: Destination for open-modal (modal id), open-page (route name), or navigate (URL). Ignored for handler type.

props.description: Additional props forwarded to the handler or modal.

handler.description: Registry key for type: 'handler'. Resolved against the customComponents map passed to CnAppRoot.

page.description: A v2 page definition. CnPageRenderer dispatches by type and matches by $route.name === page.id. All page types support a uniform widgets[] array for declarative slot placement. Sentinels (@resolve:*) are NOT allowed in id, route, component, headerComponent, actionsComponent, or slots.* — those are router and registry invariants.

id.description: Vue-router route name. MUST be unique across pages[]. Sentinels (@resolve:*) are NOT allowed.

route.description: Path pattern (e.g. '/decisions', '/decisions/:id'). Sentinels (@resolve:*) are NOT allowed.

type.description: Page type. Closed enum of 12 supported types. 'roadmap' mounts CnFeaturesAndRoadmapPage (features + GitHub-issue-backed roadmap, fed by openregister's /api/github/issues proxy). 'custom' requires a _note field explaining why a standard type was not feasible.

title.description: i18n translation key for the page title.

permission.description: Optional permission identifier required to access this page.

component.description: For type='custom': name resolved against the app-provided customComponents registry. Sentinels (@resolve:*) are NOT allowed.

headerComponent.description: Optional registry name for a component injected into the page's #header slot. Sentinels (@resolve:*) are NOT allowed.

actionsComponent.description: Optional registry name for a component injected into the page's #actions slot. Sentinels (@resolve:*) are NOT allowed.

sidebarComponent.description: Optional registry name for a component mounted as the default sidebar content for this page.

slots.description: Generic slot-override map. Each key is a slot name; each value is a registry component name. Sentinels (@resolve:*) are NOT allowed in values.

widgets.description: Uniform widget placement array. Available on ALL page types in v2 (not just dashboard). Each entry specifies a widget key, slot, and grid coordinates. The cross-field constraint gridX + gridWidth <= 12 is enforced by validateManifestV2() post-schema check.

actions.description: Typed page-level actions with a discriminator. Each action has a type field (handler | open-modal | open-page | navigate) that defaults to 'handler' when omitted.

config.description: Type-specific configuration. Shape varies by page type — see v1 schema for per-type config shapes (index, detail, dashboard, logs, settings, chat, files, form, wiki, map, custom). Config values under pages[].config may use @resolve: sentinels; the loader substitutes them at runtime. Carry-forward from v1: register, schema, columns, actions, sidebar, sidebarProps, fields, sections, tabs, content, layout, widgets (dashboard only), cardComponent, columnGroups, etc.

cardComponent.description: Registry name for a custom card component on index pages. Carry-forward from v1.3.0.

sidebar.description: Sidebar configuration. For index: object with enabled, show, columnGroups[], facets, etc. For detail: boolean or object with show, enabled, register, schema, tabs[]. Carry-forward from v1.3.0.

show.description: Whether to show the sidebar on this page.

columnGroups.description: Index sidebar column-visibility groups. Carry-forward from v1.3.0.

tabs.description: Settings tabs (for type='settings'). Carry-forward from v1.3.0.

sections.description: Settings sections (for type='settings'). Carry-forward from v1.3.0.

fields.description: Form fields (for type='form'). Carry-forward from v1.3.0.

columns.description: Table columns (for type='index' and type='logs'). Items may be strings (legacy shorthand) or column objects.

layout.description: Dashboard layout entries (for type='dashboard', legacy). Carry-forward from v1.

content.description: Declarative content items for dashboard (widget-ref items). Carry-forward from v1.

widgets.description: Legacy dashboard widgets array in config (for type='dashboard'). In v2, prefer top-level pages[].widgets[] with the uniform widgetEntry shape. This legacy config.widgets key remains for back-compat.

actionToggles.description: Built-in action toggles for type='index' pages. Each key is sugar for the matching CnIndexPage prop — manifest authors can hide built-in mass actions / row actions / the Add button without writing a wrapper. Mirrors the CnIndexPage prop names. Explicit config.<key> wins over config.actionToggles.<key> (matches the readOnly precedence rule). Distinct from config.actions[] which is the typed row-actions array.

showAdd.description: Whether to show the Add button in the actions bar. Maps to CnIndexPage `showAdd`.

showFormDialog.description: Whether the built-in create / edit form dialog is enabled. Maps to CnIndexPage `showFormDialog`.

showEditAction.description: Whether to add an Edit action to row actions. Maps to CnIndexPage `showEditAction`.

showCopyAction.description: Whether to add a Copy action to row actions. Maps to CnIndexPage `showCopyAction`.

showDeleteAction.description: Whether to add a Delete action to row actions. Maps to CnIndexPage `showDeleteAction`.

showMassImport.description: Whether to show the built-in mass Import action. Maps to CnIndexPage `showMassImport`.

showMassExport.description: Whether to show the built-in mass Export action. Maps to CnIndexPage `showMassExport`.

showMassCopy.description: Whether to show the built-in mass Copy button. Maps to CnIndexPage `showMassCopy`.

showMassDelete.description: Whether to show the built-in mass Delete button. Maps to CnIndexPage `showMassDelete`.

showViewToggle.description: Whether to show the table/cards view-mode toggle. Maps to CnIndexPage `showViewToggle`.

selectable.description: Whether rows are selectable (driving the mass-action surface). Maps to CnIndexPage `selectable`.

sidebar.description: Per-page top-level sidebar visibility gate. Sibling of config, applies to every page type. show: boolean gates CnPageRenderer's #sidebar slot.

show.description: Whether the host App's #sidebar slot renders for this page. Defaults to true.

_note.description: Human-readable note. REQUIRED when type is 'custom' — must document why a standard page type was not feasible.

allOf.description: type='custom' requires _note documenting why decomposition into a standard page type was not feasible.

visibleIfCondition.description: A visibleIf condition block. Each key is either a reserved specialised condition (appInstalled) or a dot-separated path into manifest.runtime. Values are predicate expressions (scalar for eq shorthand, or operator object). All conditions are combined with implicit AND.

appInstalled.description: Nextcloud app id that MUST be installed and enabled for this entry to render.
